scope: Limited source-assisted spot checks, not a precision/recall estimate or review of all candidates. Codex compared parser behavior with previously rendered pilot pages.

cases.finding: A top-level Date header and several nested From/Sent headers are visible. Treat them as separate source occurrences; participant redactions prevent a contact ranking.

The visible source shows a date header more clearly than the native extraction. Damaged extracted month text remains unparsed rather than being silently repaired. Repeated wrappers in the file are not automatically unique messages.
An inline date in the body is not a labeled sent date. The parser retains the body date as text and flags date_missing.

Scrambled extracted header labels and short fragments require conservative reconstruction. The outer Date value is preserved, quoted earlier headers stay separate, and fragment/body-boundary flags remain visible.
